Contribution timing: the engine deposits each paycheck's 401(k) contribution at the start of its month, before that month's return, and the statements assume the same. Had every deposit arrived at the end of its month instead, the 2025 401(k) statement would read $476,693.08, +0.31% against the simulated balance: the size of the intra-month timing a backtest against real statements should expect.
